newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian bonds/futures par losses by dull close.
newsitem.headline: Italian bonds/futures par losses by dull close.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Italian bonds and futures ended down having made up for some losses after a lacklustre session. U.S. closed for Thanksgiving holiday and Btps, lacking concrete direction, were unable to fully benefit from rise in Bunds, traders said. * Bonds:Jul06 -21bps at 108.33, yield 7.65, spread 190 bps * Futures:DecLIF -4 bps at 127.82. Res 128, sup 126.64 * Lira:firm vs mark at 987.00/7.50 after new high at 986.65 (FULL BACKGROUND / DETAILS FOLLOW)
